candidate_relations.rationale: The accepted CLI and Human-to-Agent contracts independently require apply-time validation after approval, directly strengthening the pre-approval revalidation design proposition.
Mutation tests showing stale bases and consumed approvals fail without mutation strengthen the requirement that approval never freezes project state or bypasses apply-time validation.
Mutation tests for consumed approvals, stale bases, and corrupt state strengthen the runtime proposition that artifacts and state are revalidated before transitions.
Rupi update/recovery tests requiring bounded recovery intent and replanning strengthen the handoff proposition that recovery is invoked only when required and followed by a fresh plan.
The operator-management runtime's separate protected-root transfer path strengthens the contract proposition that protected-root transfer is non-delegable and distinct from ordinary operator changes.
Project-identity bridge tests showing the first-admission base reuses explicit v2 identity strengthen the first-admission runtime's project-seeded base proposition.
Admission tests that require explicit project identity and seed canonical state strengthen the project-identity bridge test proposition.
Adversarial Rupi tests that route invalid authoritative history to exceptional recovery strengthen the ordinary-repair proposition distinguishing rebuildable projections from invalid history.
Adversarial Rupi recovery and network-blocked update tests strengthen the broader Rupi conformance record that no alternate recovery or updater path exists.
Install-primitive tests for read-only verification, explicit transition classification, and stale-plan revalidation strengthen the broader Rupi implementation conformance record.
Activation tests that fail closed on malformed or unauthorized activation state strengthen the broader Rupi/RIL conformance record around accepted authority primitives.
Deterministic RGP validation of record/relation vocabulary and provenance strengthens the output-schema proposition defining the permitted graph vocabulary.
The Phase 6 parity report's recorded PASS across framework, transaction, contract, fixture, and import checks strengthens the accepted Phase 6 baseline's PASS proposition.
The successful self-consumption isolation execution strengthens the workflow proposition by showing its accepted-release installation and source-root isolation path was actually exercised.
The runtime-isolation P5 record proving no live source checkout or network requirement strengthens the self-consumption execution record.
The P5 runtime-isolation proof strengthens the production-invocation proposition that installed runtime operates without source-repository fallback.
The preserved reference transaction's guarded reuse/update mechanics strengthen the admission-runtime proposition requiring an exact-base transaction with explicit reuse/update/new sets.
The reproducible allowlisted builder yielding stable canonical manifest/content identity strengthens the install-package content-identity contract.
Rupi update tests that reuse the installer and stop on managed drift strengthen the installation guide's deterministic update and drift behavior.
Failed-update rollback and no-false-success tests strengthen the installation guide's fail-closed update behavior.
Human-Agent tests preserving protected ceremonies as explicit adapter boundaries strengthen the Rupi authority-confirmation path's explicit protected-confirmation sequence.
The Distiller core's deterministic construction of reasoning-distiller-invocation/1 requests remains valid only against the invocation-request schema that defines those required fields and paths.
The greenfield first-invocation workflow's activation-bundle, candidate-finalization, and replay steps depend on the Distiller core that implements those invocation primitives.
Installer recovery tests that restore or finalize from journal phase strengthen the journaled-recovery proposition describing restoration/completion from durable local transaction state.
The P5 isolation proof that installer operation needs no network after package retrieval strengthens the installer-runner contract's network-independent local-package design.
